claims.title: Programmable microdevices: real connections and selective local rework

quoted_fields.interface: Actual part geometry, electrical function, mechanical retention, joining, neighboring heat, failed-part extraction, reconnecting and finite stock renewal belong to the useful assembly/rework operation. The thermal model assumes four constant-resistance diffusive metal-like bridges with Lorenz-law electronic heat flux, two lumped enthalpy/thermal nodes and an introduced melt fraction release criterion; other heat paths are not automatically removed.
quoted_fields.failure: Site binding yield is not functioning-device yield. Configurable-circuit company pages are maker claims, not a qualified delivered process or renewal life. The Lorenz model is not universal to real contacts; actual substrate, fluid, radiation and mechanical heat paths remain. Complete release/rejoin and useful device function are unconstructed. Numerical energy residuals and timestep checks validate only the declared calculation, not materials. No novel device, universal obstruction or advantage is claimed.
